plugin.name: cover-switch
plugin._long: A window switcher in the style of Compiz's Shift Switcher (Cover mode): the windows of the workspace stand in a row like album covers, mirrored on the floor, with the title of the selected window.

option.name: next
option._long: Opens the switcher, or selects the next window. Releasing the modifier picks the selected window.

option.name: prev
option._long: Opens the switcher, or selects the previous window.

option.name: speed
option._long: Duration and easing of opening, closing and moving the selection.

option.name: scale
option._long: Height of the selected window, as a fraction of the screen height.

option.name: angle
option._long: How far the windows beside the selected one are turned towards the middle, in degrees.

option.name: spacing
option._long: Distance between the windows on each side (1 = half the screen height).

option.name: background_dim
option._long: How much the desktop behind the windows is darkened (0 = not at all, 1 = black).

option.name: reflection
option._long: Draw a mirror image of every window on the floor.

option.name: reflection_intensity
option._long: Opacity of the mirror images at the floor (0-1).

option.name: reflection_fade
option._long: Length of a mirror image until it has faded out, as a fraction of the window height.

option.name: show_title
option._long: Show the title of the selected window at the bottom of the screen.
